Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or Bicep. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Azure resources to improve performance, availability, and cost efficiency. Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Azure Policy. Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms. Good understanding of cloud governance, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) , AZ-500 (Azure Security Engineer) , or AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect) . Experience designing highly available and secure cloud architectures. Familiarity with enterprise networking concepts, hybrid cloud environments, and cloud migration projects. What You'll Bring Strong ownership and accountability for cloud infrastructure. A proactive approach to improving security, automation, and operational efficiency. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Passion for continuous learning and adopting Azure best practices. Email at adil.aziz@truemedlis.com
